 Dr. Justice B.R. Sarangi
 Mr. Justice M.S.Raman
 Order
18.04.2023 Order No.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

Heard Mr. A. Acharya, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Addl.
Government Advocate appearing for the State-opposite parties.

3. The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the opposite parties to vacate the case land or take steps for initiating land acquisition proceeding in connection with Plot No. 1272,
Khata No. 467/05, Mouza- Bandhagaon measuring Ac,0.08 decimals belonging to the petitioner in accordance with the provisions contained in RFCTLAR&R Act, 2013.

4. Mr. A. Acharya, learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the land in question belonged to the petitioner and without initiating any proceeding of land acquisition and paying compensation therefore, the Mega Water Project has been set up.

It is contended that the report of the Revenue Inspector indicates that Mega Project Company is in possession of the scheduled land and, as such,
if the private land has been utilized for the purpose of Mega Water Project, steps should have been taken by the Government to acquire the land and pay compensation to the petitioner.
5. Issue notice to the opposite parties.
6. Five extra copies of the writ petition be served on Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Addl.
Government Advocate appearing for the State- opposite parties for opposite parties no.1 to 5 within three days enabling him to obtain instructions or file counter affidavit.

7. List this matter after two weeks.
